title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 The information received from 30 States/UTs shows that more than 20 types of vocational training were being imparted in the above States/UTs during the year 1996. Some of the trainings involve special skills and therefore the prison inmates are being trained in skilful vocations as per the facilities available in the prisons. From the information made available by the States/UTs, it is seen that the state of Madhya Pradesh had the provision for maximum number of (13 Nos) vocational training facilities in the jails located in the States. Other States which had more number of such training facilities were West Bengal (11), Karnataka (10), Maharashtra (9), Assam (6), Himachal Pradesh, Tripura and A&N Island (5 each).
